app_name: PerancangRPP - Sistem Desain Perangkat Pembelajaran Indonesia
audience: Guru PAUD, SD, SMP, SMA, SMK se-Indonesia, Pengawas Sekolah, dan Calon Guru PPG

entry_surfaces./: Branded education hero with platform metrics, document sample carousel, quick wizard starter, and verified curriculum badges (Merdeka, K13)
entry_surfaces./login: Branded split login — left education credential positioning panel with Tut Wuri Handayani inspirational quote, right secure multi-guru login form with demo quick-fill
entry_surfaces./register: Branded split register — left teacher onboarding roadmap panel, right teacher profile & school affiliation registration form
entry_surfaces./dashboard: Clean top-nav header with school level filter bar (PAUD/SD/SMP/SMA/SMK), document type tabs, quick action create button, and grid of created lesson plans with status & print actions
entry_surfaces./designer: Structured 6-step wizard layout with left-hand step timeline, center intelligent form with pedagogy auto-composer, and right-hand live A4 document preview dock
entry_surfaces./reference: Interactive searchable encyclopedic card grid of Kurikulum, Pendekatan (Saintifik, TPACK, CRT, TaRL, STEAM), Model (PBL, PjBL, Discovery, Inquiry), Metode, and Strategi with direct 'Terapkan ke Modul' action
entry_surfaces./document/:id/print: Clean A4 layout with print stylesheets, official kop surat header, formatted standard tables, signature block, and print trigger button

navigation.description: Sticky top bar with Kementerian/Kemendikbudristek inspired color accents, branding 'PerancangRPP', links to Dashboard, Buat Perangkat, Ensiklopedia Pedagogi, and User Profile dropdown with school affiliation badge.

kktp_kkm_calculator.description: Interactive KKTP (Kriteria Ketercapaian Tujuan Pembelajaran) & KKM module using rubrics, interval score ranges, and descriptive criteria based on Permendikbudristek guidelines.

print_view.description: Standard Indonesian official educational document formatting adhering to formal font standards, precise table borders, header kop, and double signature blocks (Guru Mata Pelajaran & Kepala Sekolah).

print_styling_rules.print_css: @media print { body { background: white !important; font-size: 11pt; color: black !important; } .no-print { display: none !important; } .print-page { box-shadow: none !important; margin: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; } table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; } th, td { border: 1px solid black !important; padding: 6px 8px; } h1, h2, h3 { color: black !important; } }
print_styling_rules.typography: Times New Roman / Arial / Georgia for standard formal government print documents, 11pt-12pt body, 1.25 line height

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade-in with slight upward slide (translateY 10px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, duration 0.25s)
motion_and_interactions.wizard_step_animation: AnimatePresence with smooth crossfade and subtle horizontal glide between steps
motion_and_interactions.interactive_cards: Hover subtle border accent shift (border-slate-200 -> border-blue-500) and 2px lift
motion_and_interactions.tooltips: Instant hover info-cards on pedagogic concepts to prevent teacher cognitive overload

accessibility_and_testids.standard: WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1 text contrast minimum)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all API endpoints follow RESTful conventions under FastAPI /api with MongoDB motor driver.

Implement comprehensive seed data in backend/seed.py containing standard Indonesian educational taxonomy: Kurikulum Merdeka (Fase A-F) & K13, 6 Pendekatan, 8 Model Pembelajaran dengan rincian sintaks lengkap, 12 Metode, 8 Strategi, dan Profil Pelajar Pancasila 6 Dimensi.
Provide realistic pre-built sample documents in the seed (Modul Ajar Matematika SD Fase B, RPP IPA SMP K13, Modul Ajar Informatika SMA Fase E, ATP Bahasa Indonesia SMP, KKTP/KKM Biologi SMA).

In Document Designer Step 4 (Langkah Pembelajaran), provide a smart 'Auto-susun Sintaks' generator button that fills Kegiatan Inti steps according to the chosen model (e.g. PBL fills 5 phases of Problem Based Learning).
Use sonner for instant toast feedback (e.g. 'Dokumen berhasil disimpan', 'Sintaks model berhasil dimuat', 'Dokumen siap dicetak').
Keep standard light theme as default with pristine educational slate & royal navy aesthetics (#0F4C81 & #0D9488). All buttons and interactive controls must have explicit hover colors.
